title: Against Great Darkness
description: Against Great Darkness is a brick breaker, bullet hell, roguelite game that launched into Early Access on Steam in April 2024. The game features multiple player characters, bosses, items, levels, a dopamine-infused game loop, and a consistent art style that I am very proud of. I am thrilled to announce that the game has sold 10,000 units in Early Access and currently holds a 95% positive review score. I was responsible for creating all assets, from coding to art, and managing an ongoing marketing campaign that has gained traction from industry news outlets and content creators.
